entries.title: I Timothy 6:1
segments: Let as many slaves as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, so that the name and doctrine of God may not be blasphemed.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:2
segments: And those who have believing masters, let them not despise [them] because they are brothers. But rather let them serve, because they are faithful and beloved, those of the good service receiving in return. Teach and exhort these things.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:3
segments: If anyone teaches otherwise, and does not consent to wholesome words (those of our Lord Jesus Christ), and to the doctrine according to godliness,

entries.title: I Timothy 6:4
segments: he is proud, knowing nothing. [He is] sick concerning doubts and arguments, from which comes envy, strife, evil speakings, evil suspicions,

entries.title: I Timothy 6:5
segments: meddling, of men whose minds have been corrupted and deprived of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness. Withdraw from such.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:6
segments: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:7
segments: For we brought nothing into the world, [and it is] clear that we can carry nothing out.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:8
segments: But having food and clothing, we will be content.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:9
segments: But they who will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and [into] many foolish and hurtful lusts which plunge men into death and destruction.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:10
segments: For the love of money is a root of all evils, of which some having lusted after, they were seduced from the faith and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:11
segments: But you, O man of God, flee these things and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, and meekness.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:12
segments: Fight the good fight of faith. Lay hold on eternal life, to which you are also called and have professed a good profession before many witnesses.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:13
segments: I charge you before God (who makes all things alive) and [in the sight of] Christ Jesus (who witnessed the good confession [before] Pontius Pilate),

entries.title: I Timothy 6:14
segments: that you keep the commandment without spot and without blame until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:15
segments: For He in His own time will reveal [who is] the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings and Lord of lords,

entries.title: I Timothy 6:16
segments: who alone has immortality, dwelling in light which cannot be approached, whom no one of men have seen, nor can see; to whom be honor and power everlasting. Amen.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:17
segments: Charge the rich in this world that they be not high-minded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, He offering to us richly all things to enjoy,

entries.title: I Timothy 6:18
segments: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to share, to be generous,

entries.title: I Timothy 6:19
segments: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.

entries.title: I Timothy 6:20
segments: O Timothy, guard the Deposit, avoiding profane [and] vain babblings, and opposing the theories of falsely-named science,

entries.title: I Timothy 6:21
segments: which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace [be] with you. Amen.
